yt_title: Day 1 of 10 — The Gate | Anaya's Ten Days EP10
short:
He came at first light.

One firecracker, because one was what she could afford.
A lunch that was a little burnt, because nobody had shown her.
And a card with his name on the front, spelled wrong.

He kept it for the rest of his life.
